goal: Behind an amp.enabled switch (off by default), let role dispatch send read-only workers to Amp orb threads with a bounded packet, collect each thread's terminal report plus its exported tool calls as audit evidence, and have installs and updates add or remove the Claude Code permission rule for amp -ox.
constraints: amp.enabled defaults to false; with it off no orb is ever started and installs remove the permission rule.
Orb workers are read-only; an amp profile on an editing worker is rejected.
Never bypass amp or Claude Code permissions; no dangerously flags.

non_goals.description: Leave the pre-existing arc upgrade and launcher edits untouched.
No editing orb workers or branch integration from orbs in this task.
No dashboard UI for the new switch.

acceptance.criterion: Config accepts the amp section, defaults it off, and rejects invalid values
Dispatcher tests pass, including amp orb workers driven by a fake amp CLI
Installer adds the amp -ox allow rule only when amp is enabled, never duplicates it, and removes it when disabled or uninstalled
A real orb read worker dispatched through the harness completes with a report and an exported audit record
